patthana21.8:1.1: Naāsavasampayuttaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavavippayutto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.8:2.1: Naāsavasampayuttaṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavasampayutto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.8:3.1: Naāsavasampayuttaṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
